$comment: Budgets from PLAN.md §12, sized for shared GitHub Actions runners (2x CPU generation variance). Times are p50 microseconds; the runner fails when a row exceeds its budget, and warns at 80% of it. `binary_bytes` is the stripped release binary: ~7 MB with `XEET_FONT_PACKS=core` (the shipped layout) and ~49 MB for a local build that embeds every face.

png_text_390_3x.what: PNG of a text post, 390 wide at 3×

png_4_photos_800.what: PNG with four real 800x600 photos decoded and scaled

png_4_photos_1600.what: the same at 1600x900: ~4x the pixels, a stress case with its own budget

explain_4_real_images.what: explain of a post with four real images (must not decode)

cold_start_us.what: cold start: process spawn plus a first render

binary_bytes.what: binary size; core-only release ~7 MB, full local build with every face ~49 MB, lazy packs 39 MB beside it
